sorts_ajoutes.description:
Steals HP in the Water element from enemies or heals allies.
Also increases the targeted ally's, caster's and all their summons' Damage.

Inflicts Air damage on enemies or heals allies.
Also increases the targeted ally's, caster's and all their summons' MP.

Heals allies and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also increases the Power of allies in the area of effect, the caster, and all their summons.

Inflicts Fire damage on enemies or heals allies.
Also increases the targeted ally's, caster's and all their summons' Critical odds.
Summons a biddable tofu that can inflict Air damage, remove Lock, and attract.
Summons a biddable gobball that can inflict Earth damage, remove Dodge, and repel.
Summons a biddable sweetoad that can inflict damage and apply a Water poison, remove Range, and move away.
Summons a biddable dragoone that can inflict Fire damage, remove Power, and switch positions.

Increases the Vitality of all the caster's summons for each enemy fighter alive.
Also applies the Pacifist state on the caster to share damage between the caster and their Osamodas summons.

Teleports the caster symmetrically in relation to the target and inflicts Water damage on enemies.
If target is a summons, also teleports it symmetrically in relation to the caster.
Moves the caster away from the targets, inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets in an area of effect.

Moves the caster closer to the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.
Also attracts summons up to the centre in an area of effect around the target.

Moves the caster closer to the target, inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels the target.
If target is a summons, also repels entities adjacent to the target.
Inflicts damage on enemies in the caster's best element and attracts the target.

Applies the On a Leash state to the target for the current turn:
• Follows the caster immediately and when they use MP.

On the caster: applies the state to all their summons.

The state is removed if the caster or the target are moved.
Summons a biddable tofurby that can inflict Air damage, teleport itself, teleport entities symmetrically, push back, and move closer.
Summons a biddable gobbulky that can inflict Earth damage, move closer, and attract.
Summons a biddable sweetoadie that can inflict damage and apply a Water poison, push back, and teleport itself symmetrically.
Summons a biddable wyrmling that can inflict Fire damage, increase its Power, and push back.

Summons a controllable gluttonous gobgob that can inflict Neutral damage based on its health, kill allied summons to increase its Vitality and MP, intercept an ally's damage, and teleport itself while creating illusions.

The cooldown period is fixed when the gobgob dies.
Increases the spell's damage for each summons in the area of effect and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.

Steals HP in the Fire element from enemies in an area of effect.
Spell damage is increased for each of the caster's Osamodas summons on the field.
Increases the spell's damage for each summons in a 2-cell circle around the caster and inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Inflicts Fire damage and removes Power from enemies in an area of effect.

Inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Entities that attack the targeted enemies are healed for some of the damage inflicted.
Applies a shield on allies and inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Moves the caster closer to the target and applies a start-of-turn Water poison on the targeted enemy.

Increases the caster's final damage and healing, Vitality, and MP.
Also applies the Pacifist state on all their Osamodas summons to further increase their final damage and healing based on their number.
Teleports the caster to the targeted cell, inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets from the centre in an area of effect.
Heals allies, inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets from the centre in an area of effect.

Attracts all the caster's summons towards the target and inflicts damage on enemies in the caster's best element.

Osamodas summons also attack if they are within range of the target and in its line of sight.
The summons' damage and healing are reduced by 50% while the spell is being used.
• Tofu: Puffed Peck
• Gobball: Gobbhorns
• Sweetoad: Croaking
• Dragoone: Dracorage
• Tofurby: Tofurback
• Gobbulky: Gobbulky Charge
• Sweetoadie: Toadcrobat
• Wyrmling: Dragon's Breath
• Scarabolt: Scarafuse
• Crackolossus: Colossal Crush
• Crocurmudgeon: Fractious Fangs
• Phoenix: Eternal Ashes
Summons a biddable crackolossus that can inflict Earth damage, remove MP, and increase resistances.
Summons a biddable crocurmudgeon that can inflict Water damage, remove AP, and reduce damage received.
Summons a biddable phoenix that can inflict Fire damage, heal, increase Vitality, and teleport itself.
Summons a biddable scarabolt that can inflict Air damage, teleport itself, remove Critical odds, and apply shield.

Switches places with one of the caster's summons and applies the Relay state to it:
• Future switches will be done between the summons in the state and the next targeted summons.

Switches are only applied if summons are within range of the caster.

Summons a controllable mischievous gobgob that can switch positions, reduce the duration of effects, and sacrifice itself to copy an Osamodas summons.

The cooldown period is fixed when the gobgob dies.

changements.avant:
Immediately minimises the targeted enemy's random effects and increases their Critical odds on the following turn.
The effects are inverted on allies.

Immediately plays the Hand and discards it in order to recover the Table on the following turn.
The Hand is not discarded if no Cards are on the Table.
changements.apres:
Immediately minimises the random effects and increases the Critical odds of enemies in an area of effect on the following turn.
The effects are inverted on allies in an area of effect.

Immediately plays the Hand and discards it in order to recover the Table on the following turn.
The Hand is not discarded if no Cards are on the Table.

changements.avant:
Uses the Winning Hand to inflict damage:
• Four Suits or Royal Straight with All Suits: damage in all elements.
• Royal Straight with One Suit: damage in the Suit's element per Card.
• Royal Straight: damage in the best element.
• Pairs or Three of a Kind: damage in the caster's best and worst attack element.

Discards Hand.
changements.apres:
Uses the Winning Hand to inflict damage:
• Four Suits or Royal Straight with All Suits: damage in all elements.
• Royal Straight with One Suit: damage in the Suit's element per Card.
• Royal Straight: damage in the best element
• Pair: damage in the best element per Pair.
• Three of a Kind: damage in the best element per Three of a Kind Card.

Discards Hand.

changements.avant:
Heals the target and applies the Lucky Star state to it:
• Applies a shield around the target if it lands a critical hit.

Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Poker if the Hand is empty.
changements.apres:
Heals the target and applies the Lucky Star state on it:
• Applies a shield around the target if it lands a critical hit (stackable 5 times).

Draws a random Card from Ecaflip's Poker if the Hand is empty.

changements.avant:
Summons an empty, static Alchemical Vial that can explode when destroyed if it is full.

On one of the caster's full Vials: consumes the Vial's contents.
The contents can also be consumed by allies by inflicting damage on the Vial.

On one of the caster's empty Vials: destroys the Vial and reimburses the AP cost.

Using the spell on a Vial reimburses the use of the spell on the current turn.
Summoning an Alchemical Vial prevents any other Vial from being summoned on the same turn.
changements.apres:
Summons an empty, static Alchemical Vial that can explode when destroyed if it is full.

On one of the caster's full Vials: consumes the Vial's contents.
The contents can also be consumed by allies by inflicting damage on the Vial.

On one of the caster's empty Vials: destroys the Vial and reimburses the AP cost.

Using the spell on a Vial reimburses the use of the spell on the current turn.

changements.avant:

changements.apres:

Also destroys the caster's Swords in the area of effect to transfer some of their remaining health to the caster.
